tools.name: get_datadog_metric
tools.description: Queries and analyzes historical or real-time metric data, supporting custom queries and aggregations. Useful for checking CPU, memory, latency, and system metrics.

tools.name: search_datadog_hosts
tools.description: Lists and provides information about monitored hosts, supporting filtering and searching (e.g. host:HP11D).

tools.name: get_datadog_metric_context
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a metric including metadata, available tags, and tag values for filtering and grouping.

tools.name: search_datadog_monitors
tools.description: Retrieves information about Datadog monitors, including their statuses, thresholds, and alert conditions.

tools.name: search_datadog_logs
tools.description: Searches logs with filters (time, query, service, host, storage tier) and returns log details.

tools.name: analyze_datadog_logs
tools.description: Analyze Datadog logs using SQL queries for counting, aggregations, and numerical analysis.

tools.name: search_datadog_events
tools.description: Searches events like monitor alerts, deployment notifications, infrastructure changes, security findings, and service status changes.

tools.name: search_datadog_incidents
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Datadog incidents, including their state, severity, and metadata.

tools.name: get_datadog_incident
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about an incident.

tools.name: search_datadog_dashboards
tools.description: Lists available Datadog dashboards and key details.

tools.name: get_datadog_dashboard
tools.description: Retrieves a Datadog dashboard by ID, returning its title, description, tags, and widgets.

tools.name: search_datadog_entities
tools.description: Searches Datadog's Catalog for service identity, ownership, and upstream and downstream dependencies.

tools.name: search_datadog_spans
tools.description: Retrieves spans from APM traces with filters such as service, time, resource, and error status.

tools.name: get_datadog_trace
tools.description: Fetches a complete trace from Datadog APM using a trace ID.
